SELECT o.status, o.fulfilment_type, COUNT(*) AS lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS dist_rl, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net, MIN(f.sale_date) AS mind, MAX(f.sale_date) AS maxd, MIN(o.dispatch_ts_utc) AS mindisp, MAX(o.dispatch_ts_utc) AS maxdisp, SUM(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_order
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id = 900
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 0 AS ret
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, 1
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
agg AS (
    SELECT sku, SUM(net_sales) AS web_net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN ret=0 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS sold_net, SUM(CASE WHEN ret=1 THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS returns_net
    FROM net_lines
    WHERE store_id = 900 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-11-03' AND DATE '2026-10-04'
    GROUP BY sku
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY a.web_net_sales DESC) AS rnk, a.sku, p.product_name, p.category, p.subcategory, p.brand, a.web_net_sales, a.sold_net, a.returns_net
FROM agg a
JOIN dim_product p ON p.sku = a.sku AND p.is_current
ORDER BY a.web_net_sales DESC
LIMIT 14
